note: Seven-site BLM campground on a 2,700-ft ridge west of San Ardo, among knobcone pine and chaparral, with level RV pads and shade structures. Reached over several miles of gravel road; avoid it when wet. Dispersed camping and a few miles of OHV routes around it. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Williams Hill: free BLM 7-site first-come campground (level RV pads, shade ramadas, vault toilets, no water), 14 days per 3 months. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin fine (at the loop). Phone empty -> 831-582-2200; website office page -> blm.gov/visit/williams-hill. OHV routes nearby (general campground, not a staging area).
flags: PHONE: stored '' -> '831-582-2200' (Central Coast Field Office, from blm.gov/visit/williams-hill). The 2023 map PDF also lists (831) 385-5434.
